slot.emptyDescription: This administration area arrives in an upcoming release.

descriptions.organizations: Status, plan, cost and budget of each organization.
descriptions.users: User search and support access, read-only and audited.
descriptions.agents: Agents per organization and the platform prompts.
descriptions.traces: Agent and workflow runs, with tokens and cost.
descriptions.evals: Datasets, experiments and the eval verdict.
descriptions.logs: Recent log lines of the local environment.

states.noAccessDescription: Your role on the platform team does not give access to this area. Ask a platform administrator.
states.mfaDescription: The administration only answers sessions confirmed with the second factor. Sign out and sign in again with the code.

overview.title: Platform administration
overview.description: Platform numbers and the areas your team role may open.
overview.emptyDescription: Your team role does not give access to any administration area.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: Status, plan, cost this month and budget of each organization.
organizations.caption: Organizations on the platform
organizations.noMatchDescription: Check the search or clear the filters to see all of them.
organizations.emptyDescription: Organizations appear here once someone creates one in the app.

filters.label: Filter organizations
filters.searchPlaceholder: Words of the name or id

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Spend, token and connector limits each plan grants to organizations.
plans.caption: Plan catalog
plans.cardLimits: {budget} per month · {tokens} tokens · {connectors, plural, =0 {no connectors} one {# connector} other {# connectors}}
plans.emptyDescription: Without a plan, organizations use the platform default limits.

form.createDescription: Set the limits the plan grants. You assign the plan on each organization's page.
form.editDescription: Saving replaces the plan's limits and updates the budget of every organization on it.
form.name: Name
form.monthlyBudgetHint: In US dollars (USD). Runs stop when the amount is reached.
form.monthlyTokensHint: Applies when the model has no registered price.
form.featuresHint: Keys separated by commas, for example: web-tools, chat.voice

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Flags of the code registry, with owner, reason and expiry. The environment value applies to every organization.
flags.caption: Feature flags
flags.organizationHint: Choose an organization to see and set its override for each flag.
flags.overrideHint: The override applies only to the chosen organization. An override cannot be removed yet, only switched.
flags.overridesErrorTitle: The organization's overrides could not be loaded.
flags.emptyDescription: Flags are declared in code. Once one exists, it shows up here.
flags.expiredAlertTitle: {count, plural, one {# expired flag} other {# expired flags}}
flags.expiredAlertDescription: Remove or renew in the code registry: {keys}

confirm.descriptionEnvironment: Applies to the whole environment and is recorded in the audit log. {reason}
confirm.descriptionOrganization: Applies only to {name} and is recorded in the audit log. {reason}
confirm.killSwitchEnvironment: Turning this kill switch on stops what it describes in the whole environment, immediately. {reason}
confirm.killSwitchOrganization: Turning this kill switch on stops what it describes for {name}, immediately. {reason}

clear.title: Remove the override of {key}?
clear.description: {name} follows the environment value for this flag again. The removal is recorded in the audit log. {reason}

costs.title: Costs
costs.description: Model cost this month per organization, against each one's cap.
costs.caption: Budgets per organization
costs.noMatchDescription: No organization is at this usage level right now.
costs.emptyDescription: Costs appear once there are organizations on the platform.
costs.gapTitle: Cost by day and by model is not available yet
costs.gapDescription: This page shows the month's total per organization. The breakdown by day and by model arrives when the platform usage API exists.

kpi.title: This month
kpi.alertHint: Organizations at the alert or above

attention.title: Need attention
attention.description: The alert fires at {threshold} of the monthly cap; at 100% runs stop.
attention.none: No organization is near its cap.

organizationDetail.title: Organization
organizationDetail.readOnly: Your team role can only view. A platform administrator changes the plan, budget and status.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Where the organization stands this month.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: The budget follows the plan unless a staff override exists.
plan.label: Organization plan
plan.hint: The change applies from now on and is recorded in the audit log.

budget.title: Budget override
budget.descriptionNone: No override: the plan's limits apply. Save values here to replace them for this organization only.
budget.descriptionActive: A staff override is in force instead of the plan's limits.
budget.moneyError: Enter an amount in dollars, for example 100.00.
budget.tokensError: Enter a whole number of tokens, without separators.
budget.clearDescription: The limits go back to the plan's. If the plan is below this month's spend, runs stop.
budget.cleared: {name} is back on the plan's limits.

status.title: Status
status.descriptionActive: Suspending blocks every member until it is reactivated. No data is deleted.
status.descriptionSuspended: The organization is suspended: its members cannot use it.
status.suspendDescription: Every member loses access until the organization is reactivated. The action is recorded in the audit log.
status.reactivateDescription: Members get access back at once.

related.title: See this organization in
related.description: Opens the area already filtered by this organization.

users.title: Users
users.description: User search and support access as a user, in one organization, read-only.

notice.title: Audited access
notice.description: Every session and every page opened as the user is recorded in the platform's and the organization's audit logs.

session.title: Session open in this tab
session.description: The session you started here, until it is ended or expires.
session.emptyDescription: Search for a user, select them and start a session below to see the app as they do.

start.title: Start access as a user
start.description: You will see what the user sees in the chosen organization, without being able to change anything.

search.title: Find a user
search.description: By the start of the name or of the email, or by the whole account id.
search.hint: The search compares the start of the text and ignores case and accents. In automatic mode, text with @ is read as an email and a whole id returns only that user.
search.idleDescription: Type the start of the name or of the email, or the account id, and press Search.
search.caption: Users found
search.noMatchDescription: Check the spelling or try the whole email. The search only finds names and emails that start with the text.

sessions.title: Support access sessions
sessions.description: The sessions of the whole team: who acted as whom, in which organization and why.
sessions.caption: Support sessions of the team
sessions.emptyActiveDescription: Nobody on the team is acting as a user right now.
sessions.emptyAllDescription: Sessions appear here as soon as someone on the team starts support access.

form.targetEmpty: No user selected. Use the search above and select the user.
form.reasonHint: 10 to 500 characters, for example the ticket number. It is kept in the audit log.

errors.targetUid: Select the user in the search.
errors.reason: Explain the reason in 10 to 500 characters.
errors.notFound: This user does not exist or has no access to that organization.
errors.forbidden: You cannot start this session. You cannot access as yourself, and the action needs the support role.

session.openHint: Opening switches this tab to the user's account, read-only. To return to the team account, reload the page or sign out and in again; then end the session here.
session.tokenUsed: This session's access was already used or the page was reloaded. You can still end it before it expires.
session.open: Open the app as this user
session.endDescription: Access as the user stops working at once.

banner.message: You are seeing the app as another user, read-only. Everything you open is recorded.
banner.messageUntil: You are seeing the app as another user, read-only, until {when}. Everything you open is recorded.

endAny.title: End this support session?
endAny.description: The access of {staff} as {user} stops working immediately. The end is recorded in the platform and organization audit logs.

traces.title: Traces
traces.description: Agent and workflow runs of every organization, with tokens and cost.
traces.caption: Execution traces
traces.noMatchDescription: Check the filters or clear them to see every trace.
traces.emptyDescription: Traces appear here when an agent or workflow runs.

filters.label: Filter traces
filters.agentInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, starting with a letter.
filters.dateHint: Whole days, in this browser's time zone.

evals.title: Evals
evals.description: Experiments with scores per scorer and the verdict, and the datasets they use.

experiments.caption: Eval experiments
experiments.emptyDescription: Experiments appear when CI publishes the evals or someone evaluates a prompt.

datasets.caption: Eval datasets
datasets.emptyDescription: Datasets appear when evals are published or an organization creates its own.

compare.title: Experiment comparison
compare.hint: Choose two experiments on this page to compare their scores per scorer.
compare.hintOne: Choose one more experiment to compare.
compare.missing: One of the chosen experiments is not on this page. Clear the comparison and choose again.

agents.title: Agents and prompts
agents.description: The core agents, their platform prompts and what each organization has enabled.

roles.assistant: Supervisor: talks to the person and delegates to the other agents.
roles.knowledge: Answers from the knowledge base, citing its sources.
roles.action: Runs commands, with confirmation and approval when required.
roles.web: Searches and reads web pages, when allowed.

catalog.title: Platform prompts
catalog.description: Agents with a versioned prompt. A version only reaches production after it is evaluated.

organization.title: Agents per organization
organization.description: Choose an organization to see and change its agents, web tools and PII mode.
organization.emptyDescription: Agent settings are per organization. The page address keeps your choice.

agentSettings.failed: The change could not be saved
agentSettings.offline: No connection: changes are unavailable until it returns.

agents.title: Enabled agents
agents.description: Subagents the assistant may delegate to in this organization.

webTools.title: Web tools
webTools.description: They only apply while the platform flag ai.web-tools is on.
webTools.firecrawlHint: Web search and page extraction through Firecrawl.
webTools.browserHint: Browser automation through a Playwright MCP connector.

pii.title: Personal data in messages
pii.warnHint: The detector records the finding and lets the message through.
pii.redactHint: Personal data is masked before it reaches the model.

prompts.title: Prompts of {agent}
prompts.description: Versions of the platform prompt. Nothing is edited in place: every change is a new version.
prompts.caption: Prompt versions of {agent}
prompts.emptyDescription: The agent uses the prompt that ships in the code. Write the first version to change it from here.
prompts.activateBlocked: Evaluate the version: only a passing eval unlocks activation.

versions.title: Versions
versions.seedActive: No version activated: the prompt from the code is in production.

eval.title: Evaluation
eval.description: Runs the agent's eval set with the chosen version and records the verdict on it.
eval.running: Running the evaluation… this can take a few minutes.
eval.idle: Use Evaluate on a version to see the result per scorer.
eval.failedTitle: The evaluation of version {version} did not run
eval.caption: Result per scorer of version {version}

diff.title: Compare versions
diff.identical: Both versions have the same text.
diff.summary: {added, plural, =0 {no lines added} one {# line added} other {# lines added}}, {removed, plural, =0 {none removed} one {# removed} other {# removed}}

history.title: Activation history
history.description: Every activation is a new record; a rollback activates an earlier version.
history.caption: Prompt activations of {agent}

editor.title: New prompt version of {agent}
editor.description: The text starts from the active version. Saving creates a new version; nothing changes in production until it is evaluated and activated.
editor.bodyTooLong: The text can have at most {maximum} characters.
editor.bodyUnchanged: The text is the same as the active version. Change something to create a new version.

activation.title: Activate version {version}?
activation.description: The version becomes the production prompt of {agent} for every organization. The action is audited.
activation.rollbackDescription: Version {active} of {agent} leaves production and this earlier version applies again to every organization. The action is audited.
activation.forceDescription: The version has no passing eval. Forcing skips that protection and puts the prompt of {agent} in production for every organization.
activation.forcedDone: Version {version} of {agent} activated without a passing eval.
activation.reasonHint: Required. It stays in the history and the audit log.
activation.reasonRequired: Give the reason for the forced activation.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.description: Runs of every organization, the ones waiting for approval, and the platform and organization schedules.

cancel.title: Cancel the run of {workflow}?
cancel.description: The run stops now and cannot be resumed.
cancel.descriptionSuspended: The run stops now and cannot be resumed. The approval request it was waiting for stays open and expires on its own; nobody is notified.

runNow.title: Run {workflow} now?
runNow.descriptionTenant: An extra run starts now, on behalf of whoever created the schedule and with that person's current permissions. The next cron fire does not change.
runNow.descriptionPlatform: An extra run of this platform job starts now, for every organization. The next cron fire does not change.

scheduleState.pauseTenant: The schedule stops firing for the organization until it is resumed. Runs in progress continue. The action is recorded in the audit log.
scheduleState.pausePlatform: Warning: this is a platform job. While it is paused, it stops running for every organization (for example, approval expiry, data cleanup or the usage report). Pause it only during an incident and resume it right after. The action is recorded in the audit log.
scheduleState.resumeTenant: The schedule fires again for the organization from the next cron time. Fires missed during the pause are not made up.
scheduleState.resumePlatform: This platform job runs again for every organization from the next cron time. Fires missed during the pause are not made up.

runs.caption: Workflow runs
runs.noStepEvents: Step-by-step events are not available in the administration; the timeline shows what the run records.
runs.noMatchDescription: Check the filters or clear them to see all runs.
runs.emptyDescription: Runs appear here once someone or a schedule starts a workflow.

filters.label: Filter runs
filters.workflowInvalid: Use the workflow id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

schedules.caption: Platform and organization schedules
schedules.emptyDescription: Platform schedules are created when the agent service starts.
schedules.noMatchDescription: Platform schedules show when no organization is chosen.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.description: External systems each organization opened to its agents. Secrets never appear here.
connectors.readOnlyNotice: Read only: the platform team does not change or disable connectors. The organization's administrators do that in its settings.
connectors.caption: Connectors of the organization
connectors.emptyDescription: Connectors are created in the organization's settings by its administrators.
connectors.tools: {allowed, plural, =0 {no tools} one {# tool} other {# tools}}, {readOnly} without approval

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Recent log lines of the web process in the local environment, newest first.
logs.count: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} (at most {limit})
logs.noMatchDescription: The buffer keeps only the last 500 lines. Clear the filters, or repeat the action and refresh.
logs.emptyDescription: Lines appear as the web process serves requests.

remote.title: Outside the local environment, logs live in Cloud Logging
remote.description: This page only reads the buffer of the local environment. Open Cloud Logging and choose this environment's project.
remote.descriptionFiltered: This page only reads the buffer of the local environment. The link opens Cloud Logging with the trace and request of the filter; choose this environment's project.
